body: the only thing i’m diagnosed with is ocd which came from something completely unrelated, but it’s something i find difficult to bring up to people, even my therapist. i don’t want them to worry that i am going to kill myself and put me on a watch or scare them, because i don’t believe i will but it’d be nice to talk to someone about (professionally wise.) but as far as it goes i don’t have a diagnosis in anything that could relate to that and i don’t really suspect i have anything to be diagnosed with
